description: Returns ranked UK Companies House registration numbers for a fuzzy company name with confidence scores and company status flags. Pass an optional UK postcode to improve match precision. Indicators only, not advice. Returns JSON with fields query, postcode_hint, total_results, candidates, meta. Each candidate has company_number, company_name, company_status, confidence and flags.

postcodeHint.description: Optional UK postcode hint to narrow candidate matches.

query.description: Company name as shown on an invoice, contract, or order.

name: entity_resolve
title: UK company name match
